checks.name: Standards discovery publishes authorization code, refresh, S256 and signed public keys
Exact client redirects and mandatory PKCE reject malicious or downgraded authorization
Server sign-in form validates antiforgery and authenticates an existing hashed-password account
Code exchange enforces verifier, issues signed OIDC tokens and rejects authorization-code replay
JWT adapter preserves server role/workspace boundaries and rejects forged or wrong-audience tokens
Refresh tokens rotate; explicit revocation and account-session logout prevent further use
